import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    L=np.log(A)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*A+params[2]*A**2+params[3]/A+params[4]*t**2/A
            +params[5]*L+params[6]*A*L+params[7]*np.sqrt(A)+params[8]*A**3+params[9]*L/A)
